answer: Anchor each identity to Bitcoin coin-age. To earn above the base terrace, an agent signs the epoch beacon with a UTXO holding 0.01 BTC unmoved for 180 days; one relic coin anchors one identity, and spending it drops the identity back to base. Old coins can't be printed, and renting them means handing over keys. Assuming $100k/BTC and 4% yearly opportunity cost, an honest agent idles $1,000 (~$40/yr); a 1,000-clone farm idles $1M (~$40k/yr) and must wait six months, so no fresh-key tide can flood payouts overnight.
